# Status

Coloured dot plus label for the state of a service, host, container or job.

`KenosUI.Status` · Homelab

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Status>…</KenosUI.Status>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Status">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Coloured dot + label for a service, host or job.

## Props (StatusProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `"online" \| "offline" \| "degraded" \| "maintenance" \| "unknown" \| "stopped" \| "running" \| "frozen" \| "error" \| "starting" \| "stopping"` | Default "unknown". Also sets the default label in the current locale (Online, Offline, Running, Stopped, Frozen, Error …). |
| `palette` | `"primary" \| "accent" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error" \| "neutral"` | Override the colour; normally derived from `status`. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Text size; the dot is 0.64em. Default "md". |
| `pulse` | `boolean` | Soft pulse on the dot for live states. Off under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | Label; defaults to the state word in the current locale. |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>._
